title: Lorentz-violating signatures in quasi-periodic oscillations from a magnetised Kalb-Ramond black hole
summary: We investigate the dynamics of charged particles around a Schwarzschild-like black hole sourced by a Kalb-Ramond field and immersed in a uniform external magnetic field. The Kalb-Ramond field introduces a Lorentz violation parameter $l$ that modifies the spacetime geometry, while the magnetic field profoundly influences the trajectories through the Lorentz force, leading to a rich variety of orbital behaviours including curled (epicyclic) motion and dramatic transitions between distinct energy boundary configurations.
